beats.say: Real Betis were unbeaten in 15 home games prior to this crucial match against Barcelona.
According to the Guardian, Barcelona defeated Real Betis with a high scoring result of 5-2.
The Guardian states that Lamine Yamal is 19 years old and conjured another magical spell.
Sid Lowe writes in the Guardian that the team passed their very first test.
Will Lamine Yamal and Barcelona continue this brilliant form for the rest of the season?

es.title: Lamine Yamal frena al Real Betis ⚽
es.summary: El Barcelona venció al Real Betis por 5 a 2 para cortar su racha de 15 partidos invicto en casa, con una gran actuación del joven Lamine Yamal según The Guardian.

pt.title: Lamine Yamal acaba com invencibilidade do Real Betis ⚽
pt.summary: O Barcelona derrotou o Real Betis por 5 a 2 e encerrou a invencibilidade de 15 jogos em casa, com grande atuação do jovem Lamine Yamal segundo o The Guardian.

hi.title: Lamine Yamal ne toda Real Betis ka vijay abhiyan ⚽
hi.summary: Barcelona ne Real Betis ko 5-2 se hara kar unka 15 gharelu matcho ka unbeaten safar roka, Guardian ke anusar Lamine Yamal ka shandar pradarshan raha.
